name: 27_single_slit_far_field_3d
title: Single slit with extended observation region — full-vector 3D
notes: Extended domain with all-side PML to suppress replicas. Chosen L=300 cells gives full-aperture Fresnel number 0.033; exact L is not specified for Fig. 6-7. Added z depth is 64 cells, dz=dx, with 12-cell z PML. The x-y geometry, grid spacing and time-step count are preserved. Each former slit is now a finite rectangular aperture 24 cells high. Illumination has a 16-cell Gaussian radius in z.
